summary:
ORBIT (Operational Readiness & Bio-telemetry) is an astronaut-centered health monitoring software prototype designed to support the health and well-being of astronauts during long-duration space missions. Space environments expose astronauts to several health challenges, including space radiation, microgravity, isolation, stress, sleep disturbances and limited medical support.
ORBIT provides a centralized health monitoring platform that allows astronauts to record their daily health measurements, monitor changes over time, identify potential health concerns and receive guidance for appropriate action.
details: ORBIT collects and monitors important health information such as heart rate, blood oxygen level (SpO₂), body temperature, sleep duration, fatigue, mood, pain and exercise. The astronaut enters daily health information through the web application. The system processes the data and compares current measurements with previous health records. It displays health conditions through graphs, charts and a dashboard. Using rule-based logic, the application identifies unusual readings and generates alerts when attention may be required. It also provides guidance and reminders to follow appropriate medical protocols
